messages:
sec-bot: automated secret-scan (git-secrets) flagged possible GCP service account key in commit abc123 in repo infra/terraform 

sarah.k: saw the alert, pulling it up now — commit is from 2023-10-12, added by a contractor branch

ajay.r: ok first step: revoke the SA key and rotate any keys that depend on it. maria can you confirm which projects/roles this SA had?

maria.p: it was a deploy-sa used by our legacy terraform pipeline for project-redwood-prod, roles/editor + storage.admin access. starting an IAM query now 

leo.t: created ticket SEC-4822 to track rotation + audit. tagging @oncall and infra. we should also check CI build logs and runner caches for the key being echoed in artifacts

sarah.k: commands I ran to confirm:
```
git --no-pager grep -n "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----" $(git rev-list --all) || true
git log --all --pretty=format:%H --grep=abc123
```
found the blob in 3 refs (branch + two tags).

ajay.r: good. maria — please revoke the key immediately, create a replacement SA with least privilege, and rotate any dependent credentials. Post the revoke time here.

maria.p: revoked at 2026-03-20T15:12:00Z. created deploy-sa-2026-rot with minimal roles (storage.objectViewer, cloudscheduler.jobRunner). storing keys in KMS-wrapped secret in secret-manager.

leo.t: updating CI: replace old service account in GitLab CI variables, purge runner caches. deploy-bot can help invalidate job-level tokens.

deploy-bot: queued job to purge caches on tagged shared-runners. ETA ~8m.

ajay.r: we need a retroactive audit of build logs/artifacts going back 18 months. create a script to search S3 artifact buckets and CI log archives for the key pattern and any base64 matches. Prefer to run read-only scans first.

sarah.k: will run pattern scan and a secondary entropy/base64+json key heuristics across artifact buckets. sample grep command: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/path - | grep -E "(-----BEGIN|private_key|\"GCP\"|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35})"`

maria.p: note — we also have to consider build log retention in GitLab (30 days for public runners). I opened support ticket with gitlab to retrieve extended logs for affected repos.

leo.t: can we avoid history rewrite for now? I prefer not to force-push to long-lived branches until we confirm all places. Instead add a redact plan and blockers for any downstream infra that still uses old key.

ajay.r: agreed. steps: 1) revoke and rotate (done), 2) CI var rotation + purge caches (in progress), 3) artifact/log scan (in progress), 4) patch any infra using old key, 5) decide on history rewrite / repo scrub if key found in many clones.

sarah.k: added an audit log entry in phalanx-audit: `action=secret_leak_detected repo=infra/terraform commit=abc123 reporter=sec-bot`

maria.p: question for security: should we automatically enforce KMS envelope encryption for all CI artifact uploads? would reduce blast from leaked keys in artifacts.

ajay.r: yes — roadmap item. short-term: require server-side KMS encryption on our S3 buckets and enable object-lock for CI artifacts. Long-term: integrate CI to wrap secrets with KMS CMKs at generation time and restrict decrypt to a small RBAC group.

leo.t: follow-ups I created in SEC-4822: add pre-commit hook / CI secret-scanning for new commits, enforce git-secrets on developer machines via devex rollout, update RBAC so deploy service account can't create other service accounts, and add audit alert threshold for any leaked keys matched by pattern.

sarah.k: one more thing — please rotate any person-issued keys that used the old SA for backfills. we found a couple of ad-hoc scripts in scripts/legacy that still reference the old credentials.

maria.p: running repo graph now to enumerate uses. will post a list in SEC-4822 and tag owners.

ajay.r: good job everyone. post-incident: we should publish a short blameless note to #incidents with summary and actions. I'll draft and share for review. :thumbsup:

leo.t: closing loop — 1) revoke done, 2) CI vars rotated in 3 projects, 3) cache purge queued, 4) artifact scan running (15% done), 5) longer term KMS and RBAC workitems created. will update ticket with scan results.
